speaker: margaret_hoby
text: The gentlemen may wait. The candles cannot. Off the floor where the men will stand. I will not have wax under a boot.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: We shall have room enough, provided no man brings his whole importance with him.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Six paces by four, sir, if I have paced it honest. The screen will serve. A stool behind it for the book.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: Put the chair there, and the king may sit in it. My father's men know where to stand. The stool is behind the screen, and the screen is not a debate.

speaker: (the steward)
text: The chair is set, my lady. The marchpane is gone. The hippocras is going.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: Sir Robert dines lightly and listens hard, Master Shakespeare. Give us King Richard whole, the parliament and all, after the marchpane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Whole, sir. The parliament is in the book tonight. It has not been in the yard.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The leaves are here, sir, and not before they were asked. They go back to the chest when we go.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have the king. I will give him with my own hands if the book says give. I am not asking the room what it would like instead.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: My father-in-law's men, Sir Robert. And a king, as I promised. He will present himself to your view.

speaker: george_bryan
text: We have bowed. The chair is bowed to. We are ready when the cloth is off the floor.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: The cloth is going. Twelve have sat. My lord is not among them, and the room is not waiting on him. The stool is for the book, and the guests are not its audience.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book stays behind the screen, my lady. The king comes out of it. We will not explain him while he is happening.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: I did not ask you for an explanation. I asked you for a king. A view was promised. A preface was not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then there is no preface. The candles are off the rushes. I will not have a helpful man do that work a second time.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Tell me where I give the crown, and I will not invent a second place to be interesting.

speaker: george_bryan
text: You give it where you stand. Gaunt dies near enough to the cloth that a skirt is a pace from his mouth. The glass, if you send for it, is a property and not a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not move a lady to make a death more convenient. The orris can stay where she put it.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: You will not move anyone. The ladies are seated. The players are standing. That is the order.

speaker: edward_hoby
text: After the marchpane, then. The king whole. I have said the sentence I mean this room to hear from me. The rest is the play, and it is not a conversation.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nine, and the two boys. Nicholas and Arthur are in their places. I am not calling a roll in this room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we begin when the floor is a floor. Whoever is in the chair has the bow already. He does not need a commentary.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The floor is a floor. Six by four. I will not pace it again.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Six by four. I have died in less. Begin.

speaker: margaret_hoby
text: Begin, then. The candles are not a prologue.
